subject: CoreHealth on-site: compressing visit — need to reschedule demo slot
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Morris <laura.m@corehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CoreHealth on-site week — demo & agenda

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for confirming next Tuesday’s on-site. We currently have a 90-minute product walkthrough booked for 11:00–12:30 in the customer lab (room B). Attached is the draft demo agenda and the itinerary your travel team shared — I’m including it as a reference.

Quick asks: could you confirm who will join from the infrastructure and security teams (Mark, is that you?). Also let us know if you want us to focus more on latency/cost controls or on private deployment options during the session — we can tailor the agenda.

I’m copying Kimberly (solutions lead) and Logan (field engineer) so they can prep relevant slides and a short hands-on checklist in case we need to compress the session.

See attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, itinerary_corehealth_trip.pdf

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Morris <laura.m@corehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CoreHealth on-site week — demo & agenda

Hi Rachel —

Quick update: our travel team just pushed a change — the executive schedule compressed our visit by half a day due to an internal emergency review. We still want the demo but need to compress the agenda into a 45–60 minute slot on Tuesday morning or move it to Tuesday late afternoon. Alternatively, if you can do a 45-minute focused session and record the deeper walkthrough for our engineers to watch later, that would work.

Attendees likely: Mark Jensen (Infra), myself, and two of our platform engineers (names tbd). Sorry for the short notice — want to avoid wasting your team’s time.

—Laura
Laura Morris
Director, Platform Integrations
CoreHealth

Laura —

Thanks for the heads up, that makes sense. Kimberly and I discussed options — here are three proposals:

1) Condense to 60 minutes (preferred): 09:30–10:30 — focused demo on routing, KV cache, and failover + 10-minute Q&A. We’ll record the deep-dive notebook and deliver a 30-minute recorded session for your engineers.
2) Split: 30-minute exec brief at 09:00 and 45-minute technical session at 15:00 (if your engineers can join later).
3) Move to late afternoon full 90-minute: 16:00–17:30 — only if leadership can free up the slot.

Practical notes: Logan can bring a small test rig and run the short hands-on if we go with option 1 or 3. If we compress to 60 minutes we’ll skip the on-prem install demo and focus on latency/cost controls + rollout policies.

I’ll hold a tentative 09:30–10:30 slot and send an updated calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) — Kimberly, Logan: can you confirm you’re good for a 09:30 start?

Rachel
